summary.intent: Execute Phase 19.1 (Extract Core Crypto SDK as Shared Package) — rewire web app hooks to use the new SDK packages instead of service-layer functions, validate the integration, and clean up the code.
summary.outcome: All 6 plans executed and verified. 10/10 filesystem operations confirmed working (create/rename/delete folder, upload/download/edit/rename/move file, delete-to-bin). Significant integration bugs found and fixed during Plan 05 checkpoint; code review pass applied additional cleanup and correctness fixes.

repo: setApiClientConfig() from @cipherbox/api-client must be called before any orval-generated function is used. Without it, all IPNS operations silently fail. Call site: apps/web/src/hooks/useAuth.ts during SDK initialization.
The SDK's CipherBoxClient uses FolderEntry.id (UUID) for children, not ipnsName. Mixing these up breaks folder navigation after creation.
SDK's loadBin() previously returned null on fresh accounts (no IPNS record exists yet), causing deleteToBin() to fall back to hard deleteItem(). Fixed by returning an empty BinState instead.

The old service layer and new SDK both write to IPNS records. Any dual-path architecture causes 409 Conflict errors due to stale sequence numbers. Solution: route all mutations through a single writer.
ensureFolderRegistered() must skip if SDK already has the folder (use client.hasFolder()) to avoid overwriting SDK's incremented sequence numbers with stale store values.
updateFolderMetadataAndPublish in sdk-core needs a 409 retry that re-resolves the IPNS sequence number — stale seq numbers from any source will otherwise kill the operation.
btoa(String.fromCharCode(...recordBytes)) will stack overflow for large byte arrays. Safe alternative: loop-based uint8ToBase64 already exists in sdk-core/src/file/index.ts.

axios.create() is called inside customInstance in @cipherbox/api-client, meaning a new axios instance is created per API call. This prevents connection reuse. Instance should be cached after setApiClientConfig().
Storing unsubscribe callbacks in Zustand state (_sdkUnsubscribe) triggers re-renders on every SDK event subscription change. These should be module-level variables.
OTP for local dev is generated by the API and logged to stdout. When API runs as a background task, read it from the task output file: grep for 'DEV OTP' in the backgrounded process output.

code.finding: btoa(String.fromCharCode(...recordBytes)) spread pattern — replaced with loop-based uint8ToBase64 from file/index.ts to prevent stack overflow on large records
customInstance called axios.create() on every API call — now cached as module-level instance after setApiClientConfig() is called
loadBin returned null on fresh accounts; now returns empty BinState (entries:[], seq:0) so deleteToBin works without requiring a pre-existing IPNS record
saveBinMetadata took 4 fields from BinOperationContext as separate parameters — refactored to accept BinOperationContext directly, removing 4-field forwarding at 4 call sites
uploadedCids was tracked for cleanup but never used in catch block — orphaned IPFS pins left on partial upload failure. Fixed by adding unpin loop in catch.
Dynamic import() calls for encryptFile and addToIpfs were inside the duplicate-files for loop — hoisted before the loop to avoid unnecessary async round-trips per file
ensureFolderRegistered called on every loop iteration in handleMoveItems but already skips if SDK has the folder — removed no-op calls inside loop
String matching on error message 'Bin not loaded' to detect fallback path — replaced with instanceof BinNotLoadedError after adding typed error class to SDK
Added BinNotLoadedError class, thrown in deleteToBin when binState is null, exported from SDK index so consumers can use instanceof instead of string matching
_sdkUnsubscribe stored in Zustand state caused re-renders on subscription changes — moved to module-level variable
_sdkUnsubscribe stored in Zustand state — moved to module-level variable to avoid spurious re-renders
SDK loadBin() must be called AFTER old initializeBin() service completes, not before — ordering matters because initializeBin creates the bin IPNS record that loadBin reads

Full SDK lifecycle integration test: login via test-login endpoint → vault → folder CRUD → file upload/download/rename → bin lifecycle. All 8+ operations verified against live API. Uses TEST_LOGIN_SECRET env var.

workflow: SDK-level integration tests (vitest against live API) are faster to iterate than Playwright tests for validating fix correctness — use SDK tests first, Playwright only for UI-specific concerns.

For Playwright MCP login in dev: trigger OTP via UI, then grep the backgrounded pnpm dev task output file for 'DEV OTP' to get the code. Do not use static test OTPs from .env — those are for Web3Auth infrastructure, not the local API.

For Playwright MCP file upload: use browser_evaluate to dispatch a custom event on the hidden file input (not clicking through upload zone overlay which intercepts pointer events). The existing E2E upload-zone.page.ts uses setInputFiles() as the canonical approach.
Use fresh random emails per Playwright test session to avoid slow vault sync from accumulated IPNS records and auth_methods constraint violations from prior test runs.

When debugging integration failures with dual-path architectures (two writers to same IPNS records), the root fix is always to consolidate to one writer — bridge patterns that try to sync state between paths create cascading edge cases.
Three-agent parallel code review (reuse/quality/efficiency) is effective for cross-cutting concerns. Overlapping findings across agents indicate high-confidence issues worth fixing immediately.
Atomic commits per fix (not per session) make it much easier to understand what changed and why. Prioritize this even when under debugging pressure.
Rate limit on OTP sends is enforced via Redis. To unblock during rapid testing: clear the rate limit key directly in Redis rather than waiting out the window.

friction: Web3Auth OTP login flow in Playwright MCP required multiple failed attempts: tried static test credentials, hit rate limits, auth_methods DB constraint violations, and expired OTPs before landing on the correct approach (fresh email + read OTP from server task output).
Playwright MCP file upload failed with multiple approaches (click upload zone, standard file chooser) before finding that the hidden input requires direct evaluate/setInputFiles injection.

Dual-path IPNS writes caused a cascade of bugs — each 'fix' to the ensureFolderRegistered bridge created new edge cases (wrong sequence numbers, wrong private keys, wrong child arrays). Took ~6 iterations to identify that consolidating to one writer was the only correct solution.
pnpm dev background task was killed and restarted mid-session, requiring re-login and OTP flow restart during active Playwright verification.
SDK integration test timeouts were 30s due to IPNS delegated routing retries in the test environment — made iteration slow during debugging.
btoa spread pattern and axios instance-per-call were copied from existing web services into new SDK packages without catching the pre-existing problems.
open_items: Batch operations (move N items, delete N items, restore N from bin) now do O(N) sequential IPNS publishes instead of O(1). SDK needs batch methods (moveItems, deleteItems, restoreFromBinBatch) to restore performance parity with old service layer.
uint8ToBase64 has 3 copies across the codebase (sdk-core/file, web/folder.service, web/file-metadata.service). Should be consolidated into @cipherbox/crypto or @cipherbox/core.
TEE key wrapping pattern (check teeKeys?.currentPublicKey, hexToBytes, wrapKey, bytesToHex) duplicated 3+ times across sdk-core and sdk/bin. Needs a shared helper.
Domain constants duplicated: IPNS_LIFETIME_MS, MAX_VERSIONS_PER_FILE, BIN_METADATA_VERSION each appear in 2+ packages. Should be exported from @cipherbox/core.

SDK @internal methods (getFolderTree, getContext, getConfig, emitEvent) are public TypeScript methods — getConfig() exposes vault private keys. Needs friend-pattern or class restructuring to make truly package-private.

Bin duplicate loading on login path: initializeBin() (old service) and getSdkClient().loadBin() both resolve the same IPNS record, fetch the same CID, and decrypt the same metadata. Acceptable during migration but should be consolidated when old service is removed in Plan 06.

ensureFolderRegistered passes new Uint8Array(0) as publicKey (not a valid Ed25519 key). The comment says it's 'derived when needed' but if the SDK ever uses this field for signing/verification it will silently produce incorrect results.
O(N) linear scan for folder lookup in folder.store.ts on every SDK event (folder:loaded, folder:updated). Should maintain a reverse map ipnsName→folderId for O(1) lookup.

Old web services (folder.service.ts, file-metadata.service.ts, download.service.ts, ipns.service.ts) are marked DEPRECATED but still imported by folder-helpers.ts (resyncFolder) and other hooks. Full removal deferred to Plan 06.
useDropUpload duplicate file path still uses old encryptFile from file-crypto.service and addToIpfs from web's IPFS module — should route through SDK client to avoid residual dual-path risk.
